_about: Every judgment constant the engine runs on, with its live value and its calibration status (RULES.md rule 5, post-mortem 2026-10-19 D-PM-1/D-PM-4). check_constants.py compares each 'value' to the live deck module and refuses an entry whose status has no record or decision. Statuses: structural = no judgment in it (format, parity hash, reporting band); measured = fit to a committed record (cite it); declared_band = hand-set, a sensitivity band is published and the report must quote it when FRAGILE; uncalibrated = hand-set, no band yet (needs a decision id); settings = read from the league settings page (data/league_settings.json). No value here is a source: the deck module is; this file says what each value is FOR and what vouches for it. A declared_band entry carries 'band': the variants scripts/redteam/sweep.py runs, one at a time, to publish the title-share band the report must quote (check_bands.py).

constants.name: STABILITY
constants.role: year-over-year Spearman rho per category, mean of three transitions 2022-23..2025-26 (the input to the season-line priors)
constants.record: report/after-reports/after-report-2026-10-09-market.md 'Year-over-year stability' (deck arena/results/actuals_2026-10-09/)

constants.name: SEASON_GAMES
constants.role: games a season of the stability sample is taken to carry (n in k = n (1 - rho) / rho)
constants.record: season_lines.py: stated assumption; the sample is players with 25+ games, whose mean games is not recorded
constants.decision: D-IS-1 (in-season after-report 2026-10-19): measure the sample's mean games from actuals_2026-10-09 and replace, or sweep 50 / 80

constants.name: PRIOR_GAMES
constants.role: prior strength in games per category for the in-season blend (derived from STABILITY and SEASON_GAMES, never tuned)
constants.record: season_lines.prior_games(); test_season_lines.py checks each value against the formula
